raw_segments.text: Allow me to caution you, sir, and to remind you once more if you are unaware of it."
The prosecutor began, with a peculiar and stern impressiveness, that you have a perfect
right not to answer the questions put to you now, and we on our side have no right to extort
an answer from you if you decline to give it for one reason or another.
That is entirely a matter for your personal decision.
But it is our duty, on the other hand, in such cases as the present, to explain and
set before you the degree of injury you will be doing yourself by refusing to give this
or that piece of evidence, after which I will beg you to continue.
